If I was Odluk, I'd have gone. He spends more time in the cell than he does at home with that awful wife he loves so much.

, he thinks.
I bet they were so happy. Orc men are always excited at their weddings.
I'm sorry I made stupid decisions that utterly ruined you
Looks like a wedding. An orc wedding, judging by the torches. Amazing that it's still standing after all this time.

I implore you to cease your operations here and leave. The pursuit of learning the demon's chaotic powers can only be described as foolish. Your attempts thus far have ended in failure, and I know not how much longer my magic will be effective in restraining it.

I will not see you risk your life, or the lives of my fellow clergymen, nor shall I be held accountable should the demon run amok. To this end, I hereby dismiss myself from this parish. I can only hope that you would do the same. -- Pastor Nikolai
Pastor Evans. By your request, I have once again sealed away the demon which lurks inside this chamber. If you are reading this note, I assume you have come to release it again.
grounds maintenance
After you. Just in case.
Anyway, we'll split the take. I open doors, you break skulls. See you!
Approaching The Great Matthaxus is not permitted. Only the fathers may speak directly to his worship. If you've questions, speak to the fathers.
By Matthaxus' command, you are ordered to leave. Walk away now.
Fortunately, they told me how to open the door already. Funny, huh? All you have to do is repeat their stupid bullshit back at them and they think you're the best thing ever.
Hey that's great! Now I don't have to share this stuff I swiped from the barracks. Just keep whatever it was you found, eh? Sounds like you worked for it.

I thought this looked familiar. I've been here. Was here for a few weeks, actually. They're a cult who worships some kind of... I don't know, God or Demon or something named Matthaxus. I left because they were too freaky for me to deal with on my own.
I'm Rosaline. Thanks for the help. Now I can fuck off with the loot and not worry about some dragon cult hunting me down and exacting vengeance. Yikes.
I'm gonna see if there's any food worth taking before I head out. Later!
Matthaxus

Okay so here's the deal. Now that you've started shit, this whole place is going to come down. That's good, it's convenient. What do you say we make a detour through the fathers' quarters and mop up some of their valuables, hmm?
That sounded a bit ugly, but you made it out in more or less one piece I see? Find anything good in there?
There, it's open. Piece of cake.

They have a room in the back that I always thought must be totally packed with treasure. We can check it out, if you want. I figured out how to pop their door locks while I was here, but never got a chance to actually do it.
Ugh, don't you just hate it when you bust your ass for the big take and it's not even that great? Happens all the damn time. Tough break I guess.

Well, that was annoying. Do you have any idea how long it took to get them to let me in here? Oh well. I've wanted to do that a few times myself over the last week or so, but you're much better at cracking heads than I am.
Well, that was fun. Now, I've never seen this Matthaxus before. I bet they just made it up to scare people. Shall we find out?
You go on in first. Let me know what you find. I can barely carry all the junk I took from the fathers' rooms anyway.
You were warned! Come brothers! Matthaxus calls upon us to defend him from these intruders!
I'll have a look at that, if you don't mind!
Idum! This is why you shower me with praise and sexual favors.
Looks pretty basic. I'll have this bad boy wide open faster than a milkmaid at mayfair.
Thanks, Peregrine. I'll keep that in mind.
You really should consider showering your number-one thief with sexual favors, you know. Just a helpful tip.
A secret tunnel like this could have any number of uses. What makes you think it was for sex?
Ah, sorry. Didn't mean to drag up bad vibes.
Ah, well. Not quite as exciting, but still pretty cool.
Come see me later, Babe. We'll see if we can get that stick out of your butt.
Grant, you're ruining my sex fantasy.
Hah!
I am a warrior, not an Incubus. Spend more time on your knives, and less on my ass.
I can still enjoy it vicariously. Let me watch you do it sometime and we're even.
I could go for one of those right about now.
I don't know Beau, you'd be surprised at the lengths people will go to.
I know, right?
I think you're full of it.
I was thinking more a late night snack.
I wouldn't be surprised. Even when we were all doing it, and we all knew about it, the men I worked with at the labour camp loved their sneaking around.
It seems like hiding a secret tunnel would be harder than hiding a secret affair.
It's been a long, long time since I've been able to do that.
Just let me have my fun, alright?
Leftie, you show me a bottle of whiskey and we'll talk.
More like contraband. Secret liquor party tunnel.
Nice thought, I guess. You really think so?
No, wait. Don't answer that. I forgot who I was talking to. How foolish of me.
No. The look on your face, however, was quite serious.
Not quite as fun, but I can still get into it.
Oh God, you're right. I'm seeing it now... the visions!
Oh, how romantic! Sneaking out in the dark of night, leaving your husband sleeping in bed, and shagging the stable boy!
Oh, so was I.
On what? If we're going to make camp here, I need to know where the rut-roads are.
Ooh, a secret passage? Handy for a late night rut, eh?
Or'pid noct.
Right now?
Right, you guys are all embarrassed about that. Weird.
Right. A bit strange, but whatever.
Saved it. Nice.
See, Rosie gets it!
Shit.
Smells like liquor. Someone brewing in the back maybe.
Sounds like a fun camp.
Stop wasting time on such irrelevant observations.
Sure was.
Sure, look at that spot right there. That's clearly an ass-print.
That's disgusting, Peregrine.
The crusader can't take a dirty joke? Colour me surprised!
The skulduggery is delightful. Very romantic.
This tunnel was added recently. Probably not for that, though.
Through a dirt tunnel though? Why not just rut in the woods?
Vank, you're an asshole.
We used these kinds of tunnels to ferret people back and forth to keep them away from town guards.
Well you know me. I'm all about being consistent.
What, do goblins just screw in the street?
What? I'm not! You should have a few drinks before you screw.
Whoah, seriously?
Yep. In piles usually.
Yes, an escape route to a warm body and a secret rut in the dark!
You can still do it in the dirt tunnel while you're in the woods.
You offering?
You think they'd spend that much time digging a tunnel for that? It seems like maybe an escape route or something.
You're such a child, Peregrine. Stay focused.
You're very imaginative, Peregrine.
Zan, for a guy who spends as much time with his ass out as you do, you have a very poor sense of humour. Aren't demons supposed to be all about forbidden fun-having?
He wanted children.
He was always free to do anything he wanted, and I was locked down! Why is that so hard to understand?!
I always thought he was on my side. I thought he understood, thought he supported me. How could he play along with such an unfair law?
I don't really care which. It's your life, after all.
I doubt anybody else here was on trial for trying to serve their country.
I gather that is the case for most of us.
I know all about Tsarathi law, Rangda. Those laws are there to keep your people alive and to keep you safe, but you could've run to the frontiers at any time and lived as free as you pleased.
I see. You knew this and broke the law anyway?
I thought after we escaped, we could go somewhere on the frontiers, like you said, and that we'd just... live. Have a few sons. Be a family away from all the laws and pressure.

If he was just a tool to achieve your goal, that's one thing, but you can't use him as a tool while crying over the fact that he doesn't love you. He is as right to seek his path as you are to seek yours.
It's better than camping out in the cold. It'll be fine.
Just because it's not easy doesn't mean you can't do it, Rangda. Isn't that the whole point?
Mind your tongue, human!
Nazar sat there beside me looking like he was going to cry. I cried. More out of rage than anything else, you understand.
No, of course not. You're right to want to be free of that, if that is what you wanted.
No. I don't have good memories of courthouses.
Not exactly cozy, is it?
Oh, please. Are you going to give me another lecture about how I should have sat in that gilded cage and played nice? I've heard it all before, so save your breath.
Perhaps you'd best mind my tongue instead.
Rangda. I didn't think anyone else was awake. Can't sleep?
So, change what you want.
That doesn't matter anymore though. I guess neither of us got what we wanted.
That was the day I lost him, the day I started planning this. And now...
The reason I took so long to come after him was because it took me that long to decide that I wanted to give him that.
Tsarathi law forbids women from serving in the military, even when they are capable. It also punishes a woman's husband if she breaks this law. It's hideously unfair.
Ugh, did I really need to know that?
Well, everyone make yourselves at home then. I'm gonna go find a place to till some soil.
What did he want?
What did your husband want? Do you know? Do you even care?
What law is that?

You are absolutely right to hate that cage you were in, but you are absolutely wrong if you think you know even the first thing about the world outside of it. The cage was a forced kindness, and freedom is limitless and cruel. Embrace it, or drag your cage behind you forever.
You chatter on over your spoiled passion play like a bored noblewoman, because that's exactly what you are.
You say that like it's the easiest thing to do.

...bridge to the pocket realm I have purchased. If I have been careful enough, no traces will remain, and it will be impossible for anyone to follow, or to undo my work. The town will simply cease to be, and the island will be better for it. -K
Aha, our jailor reveals herself! How many years now have I hunted you? How many deaths do I owe you for locking me away?
And now, you are commanded to die!
Anyone caught using the mayor's private lounge area will be severely punished.

I tried for so long to find a way to save these people from their mayor, but I am done trying. Their willful ignorance and refusal to help themselves turns my stomach, and the world will be no sorer for their loss. My patience is spent, and tonight they will all die.
Men! It is time to collect our dues!
Now, there remains only one.
Oh, I'm not going anywhere, and neither are you. While you were busy with these fools, I was busy severing the last threads that connect this place with the other side.
Thanks to your interference, my snare was nearly slipped. Take your fool adventuring elsewhere, and never return. All here are slain.
The drums have been ensorcelled and are ready for use. Once they've been lit, this well should suffice as a...
This is my realm, and it obeys my whim! You can't defeat me here! Even death kneels when I command it!
Visitors, opening the door from the outside. I wanted to thank you, but I have watched you maim and slaughter my people. Did you think that you would be allowed your trespasses without consequence?
We'll count them together, slowly, just as soon as I finish dealing with these intruders. Do stay put.
You really don't understand, do you?
You shall pay for your intrusion with your blood and your bones, and I shall from your flesh forge a gateway back into the real world!
Again? This isn't good. You guys go back to Hayill and tell the alpha about this.
Grant! It was the leeches again. The people were already dead when we arrived, and we caught them doctoring the place up to make it look like it was us.
I'd like to clean this up, but if we try to hide it, it just makes us look guilty. Leave them to the scavengers of the woods, I say. There's nothing to be done for it now.
Right. He ain't gonna be happy...
Ritter! What happened?
Still, I guess it's good that you saw this. Now you know just what kind of awful shit Frico has been doing.
They've been doing this a lot lately. Frico's vampires spot a trading caravan heading for Hayill, and they slaughter them.
What's more, they mangle the bodies and leave them in places where others can find them, to make it look like we're the ones doing it. It makes me fucking sick.
-that is, one of my cousins was the duchess there. It's a scenic place, but the only thing there of any note is the graveyard, where King Chevre is buried.

Groundskeeper

Call if you need assistance, but pray be patient if the hour is late.
I still have my key. Max always told me to come by whenever I wanted. He made me feel at home here.
I take it you know this place?
I wouldn't dare try to cross the strait by boat for fear of Leviathan, but I think that one of the royal transit lines connects. Perhaps the tunnel is still useable.
It's Maxim's hunting lodge. Or, I suppose, it was.
Max. How could you really be gone?
Mother, mother, remember me.
Spartill Lodge.
The Babe
The Babe almost surely means the Isle of Babe, off the western shore. One of my cousins is-
These premises are property of Lord Maxim Spartill. If you are in desperate need of shelter, please alert the groundskeeper. Someone will take care of you.
Well, maybe this is the only vestige of home left for me. Just promise me that you'll be respectful, alright?
Yes, I know it very well. I spent many nights here, laughing and bragging and drinking.
chasing the babe
...my last work... take it... live... and love...where I...cannot...
...thank... you..
A stone... born of suffering... to plant a seed... of love... this... you seek
I cannot see... your face... but your pain... sings to me... your intentions... give to me... the stone...
I hear... echoes. Your pain... the song of the hammer... on steel...
I've need of a smith. Will you help me?
Mercy... nary a mercy... nary a mercy...
Take it... my greatest work... yours...
Thank you friend. Rest well.
The one...who seeks... must... come alone...
You... have awakened... the crystal.  You... are the one... my grave... beneath...
Your pain... is forged... your life... through my hammer...
Ah well. I'm sure they got everything that was worth taking. Guess it's time to wander on.
I don't suppose you could get me out of here?

I was raiding the place for goodies when I got surprised by a band of rogues. I hid down here in the cellar, but the place is not in the best shape, you see, and the ceiling caved in. I'm stuck back here good and proper.
I'm Greening. This place seemed like it might have some food or supplies, so I started poking around. Those thugs either followed me, or I have rotten luck and we just picked the same target.
Oh bollocks. It's all over now, isn't it?
Oh my!
Oh! You aren't one of those ruffians, are you?

Stewpot Roadstop

Beef served every day! Come on in!
That doesn't sound good.
Well that was close. Cheers for the rescue, eh?
Ah, Dame Borgnina. Are you leaving so soon?
And I knew this, somewhere in the back of my mind, but I was still willing to force an agonizing baptism in holy flame just in case.

As for me... it seems my pilgrimage is far from over. I'll be leaving soon, but thanks to you, these sisters will never know the agony I nearly subjected them to. The suffering that would have been on my hands. Thank you.
Rangda seethes silently for a long moment, torn somewhere between screaming and crying, though she does neither.
